en.headline: Three firefighters hurt after pump part flies off at Tseung Kwan O plant
en.dek: A component detached while crews were cooling an overheated pump that had sent up steam at the desalination plant on Tuesday night; all three remained conscious.
body: Three firefighters were injured at the Tseung Kwan O desalination plant on Tuesday night after a pump component flew off while they were using hoses to cool the equipment, police and local reports said.

Police received a report at about 8.45pm of a suspected fire at the plant on Wan Po Road. Initial inquiries found that a pump had overheated and produced a large amount of steam. While firefighters were cooling it, a part of the pump suddenly detached and struck three officers who could not get clear in time.

One firefighter suffered an abdominal contusion and was taken conscious to Queen Elizabeth Hospital. The other two had contusions to the left shoulder and right thigh, and to the left hand, and were taken conscious to Tseung Kwan O Hospital.

No evacuation was required. Police said there was no evidence of a criminal offence at this stage and that they were looking into the cause. The plant is Hong Kong’s first reverse-osmosis desalination works and can produce up to 135,000 cubic metres of fresh water a day, about 5 per cent of local consumption.

zh.headline: 將軍澳化淡廠水泵機件飛脫 三名消防員受傷送院
zh.dek: 周二晚環保大道海水化淡廠水泵過熱冒蒸汽，消防開喉降溫期間機件飛脫，三人清醒送院。
body: 將軍澳海水化淡廠周二晚發生意外，三名消防員在為過熱水泵降溫時遭飛脫機件擊中受傷。
警方晚上約8晈45分接報，指環保大道海水化淡廠懷疑火警。初步調查顯示，廠內一個水泵過熱並產生大量蒸汽。消防開喉降溫期間，水泵機件突然飛脫，三名消防員走避不及受傷。
其中一人腹部挫傷，清醒被送往伊利沙伯醫院；另外兩人分別左肩及右大腿挫傷，以及左手挫傷，均清醒送往將軍澳醫院。
事件毋須疏散。警方表示，現階段沒有證據顯示涉及刑事成分，正了解起因。該廠是本港首個採用逆滲透技術的海水化淡設施，每日最高可產食水約13.5萬立方米，約佔本港食水用量5%。
